senses.gloss: (Saf. of רגל) [to lead the writer,] to rule, draw lines.
units: <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Megillah 1:9:11">Y. Meg. I, 71ᵈ</cite> top <he>מְסַרְגְּלִין בקנה</he> (for writing T’fillin) you must draw lines with a reed; <cite ref="Tractate Soferim 1:1">Treat. Sof’rim I, 1</cite> <he>הלכה … שמסרגלין בקנה</he> it is a Sinaitic tradition that we must rule with a reed (in writing sacred books).—Part. pass. <he>מְסוּרְגָּל</he>; f. <he>מְסוּרְגֶּלֶת</he>.
<cite ref="Tractate Soferim 1:1">Ib.</cite> (quot. in Tosaf. to <cite ref="Gittin 6b">Gitt. 6ᵇ</cite> <he>יריעה שאינה מס׳ וכ׳</he> a sheet (in a scroll) which is not ruled is unlawful.
